tips.text: Use Thundering Smash to close the gap, then attack to stun. Its move speed is higher when you run toward an enemy champion.
Avoid walking into crowd control with Thundering Smash active. If an enemy immobilizes you before the stun lands, it ends early, though its cooldown refreshes.
Hit an enemy with Frenzied Maul twice in a row. The second hit hits harder and heals you, so use it when you are low.
Land Sky Splitter where you will be fighting and stand inside it. You get a shield and the enemies in it are slowed.
The bolt from Sky Splitter lands after a delay, so aim it where the enemy is walking. Enemies can't see where it will land at first.
Mix attacks and abilities to build The Relentless Storm. At full stacks your attacks chain lightning to nearby enemies, so fight near minions.
Use Stormbringer to jump onto a tower fight. It disables nearby towers for a short time and slows enemies where you land, so you can dive safely.
Walk up and hit with Thundering Smash to stun your target. The movement speed is doubled when you run toward an enemy champion, so use it to close the gap.
Hit the same target twice with Frenzied Maul. The second hit does more damage and heals you, so it works well in long fights and on camps.
Stand inside the blast zone when you cast Sky Splitter. You get a shield, and enemies hit are slowed.
Keep landing attacks and abilities to build The Relentless Storm. At full stacks your attacks chain lightning to nearby enemies, so fight near several targets.
Use Stormbringer to jump onto enemies, or to disable a tower during a dive. You also get extra health and range while it lasts.
Don't use Thundering Smash when an enemy is about to root you. If you are immobilized before the stun lands, it ends early, though the cooldown refreshes.

combos.name: Sky Splitter cancel
combos.when: When you want to cast Sky Splitter without showing the cast animation during the Thundering Smash speed boost.
combos.text: Cast Sky Splitter while the movement speed from Thundering Smash is active. The wiki notes this stops the cast animation from playing, so you give less warning.

combos.name: Bolt under yourself
combos.when: When you want the shield while fighting up close.
combos.text: Aim Sky Splitter so the blast zone covers you as well as your target. The bolt lands after a delay, so cast it where the fight will be.

tips.text: Walk at Aatrox with Thundering Smash active; the extra Move Speed toward him closes the gap and the stun stops his Darkin Blade follow-ups.
Fire Sky Splitter at him when he is slowed by nothing else and stand inside it for a shield; it also slows him.
Hit Aatrox with Frenzied Maul twice in a row; the second bite hits harder and heals you, which wins the longer trade against his healing.
Step sideways out of The Darkin Blade; the edge of each slash knocks you up and hurts most, so avoid standing at the far end.
Leap in with Stormbringer when you want a fight; the slow stops him from running and you can't be pulled around by his crowd control while leaping.
Hold Thundering Smash until Briar leaps at you or you can reach her. Its stun and extra speed let you catch her and trade first.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Briar in a trade. The second hit does more damage and heals you, which counters her bleed healing.
Aim Sky Splitter where Briar will be when she charges at you. If you stand inside it, you also get a shield.
Land Sky Splitter on Briar to slow her. It hurts more the more health she has.
Use Thundering Smash to close the gap when Darius walks up. Its stun lets you start the trade on your terms.
Hit Darius with Frenzied Maul twice in a trade. The second bite hurts more and heals you.
Aim Sky Splitter where Darius will stand, not where he is. It has a delay and leaves him slowed, so he can't chase you as easily.
Stand inside the bolt of Sky Splitter when you can, to gain a shield for the fight.
Don't stay in Darius's range for a long fight. Trade briefly and step back, because he gets stronger the longer he keeps hitting you.
Use Stormbringer to fight when Darius dives you. The extra health helps, and it slows him.
Stay away from Fiora when her Riposte is ready. If Thundering Smash gets you stunned or otherwise held in place, she can parry it and stun you back.
Wait for Riposte to be used, then go in with Thundering Smash. The stun gives you a short window to hit her.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Fiora in a trade. The second hit hits harder and heals you, which wins longer fights.
Cast Sky Splitter on yourself and Fiora together when you fight. She is slowed, and you get a shield.
Look for a trade at level 6 with Stormbringer. The extra health and slow make it hard for Fiora to dive on you.
Use Thundering Smash to jump on Gangplank when he is away from his kegs; the stun stops him from placing more.
Attack a Powder Keg yourself to defuse it before Gangplank can blow it up on you.
Save Thundering Smash until Gangplank has used Remove Scurvy, since it cleanses the stun.
Use Frenzied Maul twice in a row on Gangplank; the second bite hits harder and heals you back after his pokes.
Watch for Gangplank's level 6; his Cannon Barrage can hit you from anywhere, so avoid fights at low health.
Do not fight Garen when Decisive Strike is ready. His silence cuts your abilities off mid-trade.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Garen in a trade; the second bite hits harder and heals you.
Cast Sky Splitter so Garen is in the circle, and stand inside it yourself to get a shield.
Do not hit Garen while he stands in a bush. You walk into full Judgment damage.
Back away from Garen when your health is low. Demacian Justice deals more damage the less health you have.
Use Thundering Smash to close the gap when Jayce is in Cannon Stance; the extra speed towards him lets you reach him and stun him.
Do not rush into Jayce's Thundering Blow. If he roots or knocks you back during Thundering Smash, it ends early.
Hit Jayce with Frenzied Maul twice in a row. The second hit deals more damage and heals you.
Aim Sky Splitter where Jayce will stand while he pokes you. Stand inside it yourself to gain a shield.
Enemies cannot see Sky Splitter land for the first moment, so cast it onto Jayce when he is about to leap or fight in melee.
Walk up with Thundering Smash active when you want to trade; it speeds you toward K'Sante and stuns on your next attack.
Hit K'Sante with Frenzied Maul twice in a trade; the second bite hits harder and heals you.
Aim Sky Splitter where K'Sante will stand, and stand inside it yourself to get the shield. It also leaves him slowed.
Do not start Thundering Smash while K'Sante can stun or pull you first. If you are immobilized before you land the stun, it ends early.
Use Stormbringer to close the gap or to disable the tower when you dive; the extra health helps in the fight that follows.
Save Thundering Smash for when Malphite is in range. Close the gap with its extra speed toward champions, then stun him with your next attack.
Do not rely on long auto-attack trades into Ground Slam; it cuts your Attack Speed, so use Frenzied Maul to deal damage instead.
Aim Sky Splitter where Malphite will stand and stand inside it yourself; you get a shield and he is slowed.
Hit Malphite twice with Frenzied Maul to bite him and heal; it works well when you are hurt after a trade.
Do not stand grouped when Malphite has Unstoppable Force ready; step away from him so it does not knock you up.
Do not fight Mordekaiser in a long trade when Darkness Rise is on. Back off and wait for it to fade.
Save Thundering Smash for when Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp is on cooldown. If you are immobilized before you land the stun, it ends early.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Mordekaiser. The second bite hits harder and heals you, which helps against his damage.
Hit Mordekaiser with Sky Splitter when he is slowed or walking onto it. The bolt lands late, so aim ahead of him.
Trade into Indestructible's shield only when it is down; his shield grows the more you fight him.
Close in with Thundering Smash to stun Rumble. Land the stun, then fight him before he can use his spells.
Wait until Rumble Overheats, then go in. He can't cast spells for a few seconds, so he can't slow you or shield himself.
Step out of The Equalizer's burning trail quickly. Staying inside it costs you a lot of health and slows you.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Rumble to heal back the health that Flamespitter took. Do it when you are trading in close.
Sky Splitter hits hard on a high-health target and slows him. Throw it where Rumble stands to trade, and stand inside it for a shield.
Run at Sion with Thundering Smash while he is not charging, and stun him. Stay out of his line while he charges Decimating Smash.
Step out of the line of Roar of the Slayer. It slows you and is often used to set up a stunning Decimating Smash.
Use Frenzied Maul twice in a row on Sion. The second bite hits harder and heals you.
Hold back Sky Splitter until Sion is slowed or committed. Standing in the bolt yourself gives you a shield.
Do not trade into Sion when his Soul Furnace shield is up; wait for it to fade or be broken.
Walk toward Teemo with Thundering Smash ready; the stun lets you land attacks on him. Use it as your way to close in.
Use Frenzied Maul even while blinded; it cannot miss, and your normal attacks will.
Watch for bushes. Teemo hides in them unseen, so do not walk in blindly.
Cast Sky Splitter onto Teemo when he is standing still or farming, and stand inside it to gain a shield.
Mushrooms are hidden, so use the ground you can see to be careful. Avoid chasing through places he may have planted Noxious Trap.
Use Stormbringer in a longer fight, once you are on top of him, for extra health and reach.
Use Thundering Smash to close the gap on Vayne; it gives you speed toward her and a stun on your hit.
Don't stand next to a wall when Vayne is in range; Condemn will pin you and stun you.
Hit Vayne with Frenzied Maul twice in a row; the second bite hurts more and heals you.
Cast Sky Splitter where Vayne will dodge to, such as her escape path; it slows her.
Fight Vayne early; she is weak before she has her items and Silver Bolts hurts less.
Use Thundering Smash to close the gap when Yone steps up. The stun gives you a free trade, and the Move Speed doubles when you run at him.
Cast Sky Splitter where Yone will stand, not where he is now. It slows him and hits for a share of his max Health.
Hit Yone with Frenzied Maul twice in a trade. The second hit hurts more and heals you, so you win the longer fights.
Take a trade when Yone's Mortal Steel is on cooldown. Without it he can't easily poke you or build up his knock up.
Use Stormbringer in a big fight. The extra Health helps you survive his burst, and the slow gives you a chance to catch him.
Use Thundering Smash to close in on Graves; the stun stops him from kiting you. Do not run at him with it already spent.
Stand in your own Sky Splitter circle to get the shield, and use it on Graves when he stops to fight.
Chew on Graves with Frenzied Maul twice; the second bite hits harder and heals you, which helps against his burst.
Stay out of Smoke Screen; leaving the cloud removes its slow at once.
Stormbringer makes you sturdier and gives you more attack range, so start the fight with it when Graves has used Quickdraw.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or Dragon Strike will knock you up.
If Jarvan knocks you up or otherwise immobilizes you, Thundering Smash ends early, but its cooldown comes back. Use it again once you are free.
Fight with Frenzied Maul twice in a row. The second bite heals you and hits harder, which wins long trades against Jarvan.
Cast Sky Splitter where Jarvan will stand inside his own Cataclysm arena; he cannot easily walk out of it.
Use Thundering Smash to chase Kayn; the faster run towards him closes the gap and the hit stuns him.
Aim Sky Splitter where Kayn will end up, not where he stands. It slows him and hits hard against his max Health.
Hit Kayn twice with Frenzied Maul in a fight. The second hit does more damage and heals you.
Land Stormbringer on Kayn when he commits; the extra Health helps you outlast his burst.
Do not spend Thundering Smash when Kayn can slow or stun you first. If he immobilizes you, it ends early.
Stay near allied minions or teammates so Kha'Zix cannot catch you isolated, because Taste Their Fear hits an isolated target far harder.
Stun Kha'Zix with Thundering Smash when he leaps in, then follow with Frenzied Maul to win the short fight.
Fight when Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown. Kha'Zix has no easy escape then, and Sky Splitter slows him as he runs.
Use Stormbringer when you commit to a fight. The extra Health helps you outlast Kha'Zix's burst.
Chase Kindred with Thundering Smash; the extra speed toward enemy champions closes the gap and the stun stops her from vaulting away.
Kindred is fragile, so dive her when she is out of position. Sky Splitter slows her and deals extra damage because she has less max Health than a tank.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Kindred in a fight; the second hit hurts more and heals you.
Don't use Stormbringer on top of Lamb's Respite. Enemies inside it can't die, so wait for it to end before you finish her.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Lee Sin in a fight; the second bite hits harder and heals you.
Save Thundering Smash for when Lee Sin commits; if he stuns or roots you first, you lose it, so don't use it where he can interrupt you.
Stand inside Sky Splitter when it lands to get a shield, and fight him there.
Lee Sin's Sonic Wave stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and him when you can.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage; the lightning from The Relentless Storm helps you win a long fight.

comboRefs.note: Sky Splitter covering Volibear up close gives a shield, which helps in a brawl against Lee's Tempest and Q.

tips.text: Hold Thundering Smash until Master Yi commits. A stun on him stops his attacks and wastes his Alpha Strike.
Aim Sky Splitter where Master Yi will stand. It slows him, and Highlander cannot be used to remove it once it lands.
Bite with Frenzied Maul twice in a trade. The second bite hits harder and heals you, which beats Meditate.
Use Stormbringer at level 6 to cover his Alpha Strike chase. You are immune to crowd control while you leap.
Hold Thundering Smash for when Naafiri dashes in or tries to run; the move speed closes the gap and the stun lets you finish her.
Use Sky Splitter on her when she is hurt. It hits for a share of her max Health and leaves her slowed, so she cannot easily get away.
Cast Sky Splitter over yourself when you expect a fight. You get a shield if you stand in the blast zone, which helps against her burst.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on her in a fight. The second hit deals more damage and heals you, which wins long trades.
Save Stormbringer for when she dives or commits. The extra Health and the slow on nearby enemies make you hard to kill.

comboRefs.note: Sky Splitter's shield helps in close fights against Naafiri and her packmates' burst.

tips.text: Save Thundering Smash to chase Nocturne, then hit him to stun. Beware the shield from Shroud of Darkness, which blocks it.
Bait out Shroud of Darkness with a cheap ability first, then use Frenzied Maul and Thundering Smash while it is down.
Stay near your team when Paranoia goes off; Nocturne dives one target and your allies can punish him.
Walk out of range when Unspeakable Horror is cast so the tether breaks and you avoid the fear.
Use Stormbringer in a brawl for extra health and a slow on nearby enemies, which makes it hard for Nocturne to escape.
Save Thundering Smash for when Shyvana is out of her shield; the stun lets you hit her freely.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Shyvana in a fight; the second bite hurts more and heals you.
Dodge Molten Burst by stepping sideways; once she is slowed you cannot catch her easily.
Fight when Shyvana is low on Fury, before she can use Dragon's Descent.
Don't let Skarner drag you into a wall with Ixtal's Impact; a stun or knock up from an ally stops his charge.
Use Thundering Smash to close in on Skarner and stun him, but be careful: if he stuns you first, it ends early.
Use Frenzied Maul twice in a row on Skarner to deal more damage and heal in a long fight.
Put Sky Splitter on Skarner when he starts to charge or fight; it slows him, and you get a shield if you stand in it.
Don't wait around in a drawn-out fight; Skarner's Quaking damage builds up if he keeps hitting you.

comboRefs.note: Sky Splitter's bolt lands late, so cast it where the fight will be, as Skarner charges in.

tips.text: Hit Sylas with Sky Splitter when he commits to a fight; the bolt scales with his max Health and leaves him slowed so you can catch him.
Open with Thundering Smash to close the gap; the bonus speed is higher toward enemy champions, and the hit stuns him.
Play around his Abduct. If it stuns you before you land Thundering Smash, that ability ends early.
Use Frenzied Maul twice in a fight. The second hit hurts more and heals you, which helps against his Kingslayer healing.
Land Stormbringer on him in a brawl; the extra Health and slow let you win the fight in close range.
Save Thundering Smash to stun Talon when he jumps in. He cannot burst you if he is stunned.
Fight Talon in long trades. Use Frenzied Maul twice on him to heal and outlast his burst.
Cast Sky Splitter where Talon will stand or flee. It slows him and shields you when you stand inside it.
Chase Talon hard while Shadow Assault is down, since he has no easy escape then.
Talon deals only physical damage, so extra health and toughness from Stormbringer helps you survive his burst.
Use Thundering Smash to close on Viego; the faster chase speed toward enemy champions helps you reach him, and your next Attack stuns him.
Hit Viego with Frenzied Maul twice in a fight; the second bite hurts more and heals you.
Cast Sky Splitter where Viego will be standing or running to; it slows him, and you get a shield if you stand in it.
Fight Viego away from fresh kills. A dead champion near him can turn into a wraith he eats to heal and copy them, so avoid trading into that.
Use Stormbringer to leap onto Viego in a brawl. The extra health helps you win the longer fight.
Do not walk into Xin Zhao's Three Talon Strike. His third hit knocks you up, and your Thundering Smash fails if you are immobilized first.
Use Frenzied Maul twice on Xin Zhao: the second bite hits harder and heals you, which wins long trades.
Put Sky Splitter on Xin Zhao as he commits; it slows him. Stand inside the bolt to gain a shield.
Stay out of a line from Xin Zhao, because Wind Becomes Lightning slows you and marks you as Challenged, which lets his charge reach farther.
Stormbringer gives you extra health and immunity to crowd control during the leap, so use it to start a fight when Xin Zhao's Crescent Guard is down.
